body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Evaluates network performance under interference, congestion, and outages. A resilient-network simulator models wireless and wired networks with mobility, interference, and failures, measuring delivery ratio, latency, and recovery time. Real implementations include ns-3, OMNeT++, and CORE/EMANE. It tests mesh, MANET, and 5G configurations for field robotics. Engineering use only.

body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Teaching ladder for Resilient Communications Network Simulator, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Packet-level simulation: Wi-Fi, LTE/5G, mesh). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Packet-level simulation: Wi-Fi, LTE/5G, mesh and Mobility and propagation models.
